title: bambamR: End-to-end RNA-seq processing from FASTQ to publication-ready plots
description: bambamR is a toolkit that carries bulk RNA-sequencing data through a complete analysis path in a single environment. It covers FASTQ and BAM import, quality control, alignment, read counting, normalisation and differential expression testing, and finishes with publication-ready graphics including volcano plots, heatmaps, oncoplots and principal component plots. The package runs in a minimal mode that depends only on CRAN packages, or in a fuller mode when Bioconductor packages are present, so it can be used on restricted systems. It is intended for biologists and bioinformaticians who want a reproducible transcriptomics workflow without assembling a pipeline from separate tools.
